name: Amplifire — with no card linked yet the fired trigger changes nothing
notes: Sweep group 4 (2026-10-07). Linked cards: a permanent or fired ability holds the cards it reads values from although they are in no zone the site shows ("Linked card" button on the timeline row; saved with the board). Until a revealed card is linked, the fired trigger leaves Amplifire at its printed 1/1 rather than 0/0.
